notes: Abstract-only: the 15–34 % and 26–33 % values agree with the abstract but stay unchecked under the brief's rule 1; 1–4 % and the lake description need the full text. The article says it is based on Clady's University of Michigan PhD dissertation (Clady 1970, the Sylvania lakes), which would be a stand-in if a free copy exists (none found). OpenAlex's 'abstract' field for this DOI also holds text scraped from a JSTOR download (pp. 194–196, cut off mid-Table 1); that is not an acceptable copy and was not used to check anything. The 'Clady, via Dahlberg 1979' perch-viability mentions in §3.6.1 are not this paper (it is about smallmouth bass): the research note egg_survival_and_larval_production.md says Dahlberg's citation is almost certainly Clady 1976 (JFRBC 33: 1887–1893) — the paper should give that year.
